name: dnd-master-screen
description: DM screen: show your images (a folder or Notion) on the players' monitor

scripts.build:mac: NODE_ENV=production bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 src/main.ts --outfile dist/dnd-master-screen-mac && codesign --force --sign - dist/dnd-master-screen-mac
scripts.build: bun run build:mac && bun run build:win
scripts.package: bun run build && cd dist && rm -f *.zip && ditto -c -k dnd-master-screen-mac dnd-master-screen-mac.zip && zip -q -9 dnd-master-screen-windows.zip dnd-master-screen.exe
